notes: Your kit keeps its inner workings to itself now: notes about its own memory system no longer appear in your views, your search, or your postcards, and it answers briefly by default.
Everything your kit says uses your name and its own, everywhere.
The answer box over the memories view can be collapsed, and the welcome message on a young kit can be dismissed, so the field is always yours to see.
The Ask tab is tucked away for now; asking from the memories view is the front door.
